parts.t: West Coquitlam sits at the intersection of three municipalities — Coquitlam, Burnaby, and Port Moody — and benefits from some of the best transit connectivity in the Tri-Cities. With a growing condo market and increasing walkability, it appeals strongly to commuters, young professionals, and investors.
